environment.description: CLI tool deployed on shared EC2 instance with IAM instance profile 'notes-app-role'. The role has a broad DynamoDB policy: dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:Query, dynamodb:DeleteItem, dynamodb:PutItem on resource arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:123456789012:table/tenant_notes with no condition keys. Users authenticate via --user-id flag which is self-asserted. No SCP or permission boundary applied.

config.runtime: EC2 instance with shared access, no network segmentation
